newsitem.title: FRANCE: OECD warns of risk of share market correction.
newsitem.headline: OECD warns of risk of share market correction.

text.p: The Organisation of Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) said on Thursday that there was a danger of a correction in share markets which would depress economic demand.
"The recent buoyancy of equity markets in North America and Europe may be read in two ways," the OECD said in its half-yearly Economic Outlook.

"It may reflect an underlying improvement in prospects for growth and profits which is not fully reflected in the (OECD's economic) projection, but there is also the danger of a correction that could depress demand," it added.
The Wall Street share market, London's FTSE share index and equity in Frankfurt have recently hit all-time highs.
